module_summary: PTP timestamp clock-domain crossing: captures source timestamps, toggle-synchronizes them to output_clk, and a PI loop disciplines a local ns/s counter with sample_clk phase detection and lock tracking.

anchors.name: input_ts
anchors.why: Source PTP timestamp captured in input_clk domain into src_ts capture registers.

anchors.name: output_ts
anchors.why: Output timestamp formed from local ts_s_reg and ts_ns_reg.

anchors.name: ts_ns_reg
anchors.why: Local nanosecond time counter in output_clk domain, advanced by period_ns.

anchors.name: period_ns_reg
anchors.why: PI-controlled clock increment per cycle driving the local time counter.

anchors.name: ts_s_reg
anchors.why: Local seconds counter incremented on ns overflow or loaded from source.

anchors.name: locked
anchors.why: Lock status: ptp, frequency and dest-sync loops all locked.

anchors.name: src_ts_ns_capt_reg
anchors.why: Source ns timestamp captured on src_update in input_clk domain.

anchors.name: src_sync_reg
anchors.why: Toggle flag signalling new source capture across clock domains.

anchors.name: src_ts_ns_sync_reg
anchors.why: Source timestamp transferred into output_clk domain on synchronized toggle.

anchors.name: dest_ts_ns_capt_reg
anchors.why: Local timestamp snapshot on dest_update for comparison with source.

anchors.name: ts_ns_diff_reg
anchors.why: Time error between source and local timestamps feeding PI control.

anchors.name: time_err_int_reg
anchors.why: PI integrator of time error, saturating, used to compute period_ns.

anchors.name: ts_sync_valid_reg
anchors.why: New synchronized source timestamp available; with capture valid triggers comparison/load.

anchors.name: dest_phase_reg
anchors.why: Destination phase accumulator whose overflow generates dest_update capture strobes.

anchors.name: dest_update_reg
anchors.why: Strobe capturing local timestamp and toggling dest_sync_reg.

anchors.name: freq_locked_reg
anchors.why: Coarse frequency lock; gates fine time-difference use and ptp lock.

anchors.name: output_pps
anchors.why: Pulse-per-second output from seconds rollover (pps_reg).

anchors.name: src_update_reg
anchors.why: Source phase counter carry enabling timestamp capture in input_clk domain.

anchors.name: src_phase_reg
anchors.why: Free-running input_clk divider producing src_update every 2^LOG_RATE cycles.

anchors.name: src_sync_sync2_reg
anchors.why: Representative synchronizer stage; edge with sync3 loads src_ts sync registers.

anchors.name: src_ts_step_sync_reg
anchors.why: Synchronized source step flag forcing direct timestamp load.

anchors.name: ts_capt_valid_reg
anchors.why: Local capture valid, paired with ts_sync_valid_reg for comparison.

anchors.name: dest_phase_inc_reg
anchors.why: Destination phase increment controlled by sample-clock phase loop.

anchors.name: dest_err_int_reg
anchors.why: Integrator of sampled phase error for destination phase increment.

anchors.name: sample_acc_reg
anchors.why: sample_clk phase detector accumulator of src/dest sync edge differences.

anchors.name: edge_1_reg
anchors.why: Phase-frequency detector edge-order flag in sample_clk domain.

anchors.name: sample_update_reg
anchors.why: Toggle announcing new sample accumulator result to output_clk domain.

anchors.name: sample_acc_sync_reg
anchors.why: Phase-detector result transferred into output_clk domain.

anchors.name: sample_acc_sync_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pulse enabling destination phase loop update.

anchors.name: sample_cnt_reg
anchors.why: sample_clk window counter dumping phase accumulator.

anchors.name: dest_sync_locked_reg
anchors.why: Destination phase loop locked; selects loop gains and feeds locked.

anchors.name: dest_sync_lock_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts consecutive small phase errors before dest sync lock.

anchors.name: dest_sync_reg
anchors.why: Toggle on local capture, synchronized into sample_clk detector.

anchors.name: phase_err_out_reg
anchors.why: Coarse phase error from output_clk detector driving frequency lock.

anchors.name: phase_err_out_valid_reg
anchors.why: Valid pulse for coarse phase error window result.

anchors.name: phase_err_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Window counter for coarse phase error accumulation.

anchors.name: gain_sel_reg
anchors.why: Selects PI loop gain based on time error magnitude.

anchors.name: ts_diff_valid_reg
anchors.why: Enables PI update and mismatch counting for a new difference.

anchors.name: ts_diff_reg
anchors.why: Coarse timestamp mismatch flag counted by mismatch_cnt.

anchors.name: mismatch_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Counts repeated mismatches before forcing timestamp reload.

anchors.name: load_ts_reg
anchors.why: Forces local time to load source timestamp after mismatches.

anchors.name: ptp_locked_reg
anchors.why: Fine PTP lock flag contributing to locked output.

anchors.name: freq_lock_count_reg
anchors.why: Up/down counter qualifying frequency lock.

anchors.name: ptp_lock_count_reg
anchors.why: Up/down counter qualifying PTP time lock.

anchors.name: ts_ns_inc_reg
anchors.why: Pre-computed next ns value for the local counter.

anchors.name: ts_ns_ovf_reg
anchors.why: Seconds-overflow lookahead; borrow bit triggers seconds increment and PPS.

anchors.name: ts_step_reg
anchors.why: Step indication when local time loaded from source.

anchors.name: input_ts_step
anchors.why: Source step indication forcing timestamp reload.

anchors.name: output_ts_step
anchors.why: Output step flag copied from ts_step_reg.

groups.name: Source capture (input_clk)
groups.description: Captures source timestamp every 2^LOG_RATE input cycles and toggles src_sync.

groups.name: Timestamp CDC
groups.description: Synchronizers moving captured source timestamp into output_clk domain.

groups.name: Local PTP clock
groups.description: ns/seconds counter advanced by period_ns, producing output_ts and PPS.

groups.name: Time comparator and PI loop
groups.description: Compares source vs local time and adjusts period_ns via gain-scheduled PI control.

groups.name: Destination phase loop
groups.description: sample_clk phase detector aligning dest capture strobes to source capture timing.

groups.name: Coarse phase detector
groups.description: output_clk phase comparison of src/dest phase bits for frequency acquisition.

groups.name: Lock detection
groups.description: Frequency and PTP lock counters combined into locked status.
